attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OPNsense) with the os-haproxy plugin as a single HTTP load-balancing entry point on its management address (10.100.139.10:80), distributing round-robin across identifying HTTP backends running on node2 and node3 (port 8080, persistent systemd services). Verified node4 receives alternating responses from both backends through the load balancer. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol on all 4 nodes sequentially, each confirmed via a changed OS-native boot marker (kern.boottime for FreeBSD/OPNsense, /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id for Ubuntu nodes) and full post-restart recovery of services and the load-balanced HTTP path.
